title: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Readiness
description: Magento readiness checks mapped to PCI DSS v4.0.1 requirements. Results provide scoped evidence and do not certify PCI DSS compliance.

mapping_policy.DIRECT: The rule tests the complete technical criterion represented by this mapping.
mapping_policy.PARTIAL: The rule tests a material subset; additional technical or human evidence is required.
mapping_policy.SUPPORTING: The rule supplies useful evidence but cannot establish the requirement by itself.
mapping_policy.HUMAN: The requirement depends on mandatory human assessment and documentary evidence.

mappings.rationale: No world-writable files or directories: this rule tests a material part of the criterion but not its full operational scope for PCI DSS 2.2.1.
env.php restricted to owner/group access: this rule supplies supporting implementation evidence without establishing compliance for PCI DSS 7.2.1.
Webroot hygiene (no .git/.env/backups in pub/): this rule tests a material part of the criterion but not its full operational scope for PCI DSS 2.2.1.
Code directories are read-only: this rule supplies supporting implementation evidence without establishing compliance for PCI DSS 6.5.2.
Code directories are read-only: this rule supplies supporting implementation evidence without establishing compliance for PCI DSS 11.5.2.
Directory listing disabled: this rule tests a material part of the criterion but not its full operational scope for PCI DSS 2.2.1.
Admin 2FA module enabled: this rule tests a material part of the criterion but not its full operational scope for PCI DSS 8.4.2.
Admin 2FA module enabled: this rule tests a material part of the criterion but not its full operational scope for PCI DSS 8.4.3.

Assess MFA enforcement for all non-console administrative access into the CDE. Magebean supplies partial local technical evidence; the remaining PCI testing procedures require human assessment and, where applicable, external-system evidence.
Admin passwords require at least 8 characters: this rule tests a material part of the criterion but not its full operational scope for PCI DSS 8.3.6.
Admin session timeout <= 900s: this rule directly tests the stated technical criterion for PCI DSS 8.2.8.
Admin URL exposure restricted: this rule supplies supporting implementation evidence without establishing compliance for PCI DSS 7.2.1.
Login rate-limiting / CAPTCHA enabled: this rule tests a material part of the criterion but not its full operational scope for PCI DSS 8.3.4.
Use CSPRNG; avoid weak PRNG: this rule tests a material part of the criterion but not its full operational scope for PCI DSS 6.2.4.
Sensitive data not logged: this rule supplies supporting implementation evidence without establishing compliance for PCI DSS 3.3.1.
Force HTTPS in admin and storefront: this rule tests a material part of the criterion but not its full operational scope for PCI DSS 4.2.1.
Force HTTPS in admin and storefront tests browser-based Magento administration, providing partial evidence for PCI DSS 2.2.7; other administrative paths remain outside this rule.
HSTS max-age is at least one year: this rule supplies supporting implementation evidence without establishing compliance for PCI DSS 4.2.1.
HSTS helps prevent browser downgrade to cleartext access and supplies supporting evidence for PCI DSS 2.2.7, but it does not establish strong cryptography for every administrative path.
TLS protocols >= 1.2: this rule tests a material part of the criterion but not its full operational scope for PCI DSS 4.2.1.
Observed TLS 1.2 or later provides partial protocol evidence for PCI DSS 2.2.7 on the scanned web endpoint, not for every in-scope component or remote administration method.
No mixed content (http://) in templates/assets: this rule supplies supporting implementation evidence without establishing compliance for PCI DSS 4.2.1.
Magento runs in PRODUCTION mode: this rule tests a material part of the criterion but not its full operational scope for PCI DSS 2.2.1.
Magento runs in PRODUCTION mode: this rule supplies supporting implementation evidence without establishing compliance for PCI DSS 6.5.2.
Magento production mode is a concrete application security parameter and provides partial evidence for PCI DSS 2.2.6.
Xdebug disabled in production: this rule tests a material part of the criterion but not its full operational scope for PCI DSS 2.2.1.
Disabled Xdebug is a concrete PHP security parameter and provides partial evidence for PCI DSS 2.2.6.
display_errors is Off: this rule tests a material part of the criterion but not its full operational scope for PCI DSS 2.2.1.
Disabled error display is a concrete PHP security parameter and provides partial evidence for PCI DSS 2.2.6.

Logs and reports not exposed under pub/: this rule tests a material part of the criterion but not its full operational scope for PCI DSS 10.3.1.
